name: Global Illumination via Hemisphere Sampling
definition: A Global Illumination solution that models light bounces from the sky by creating a virtual skybox of infinite directional lights casting inwards, sampling the skybox over a hemisphere directed away from the surface normal to contribute diffuse illumination.
summary: Global Illumination via Hemisphere Sampling models single-bounce sky light by integrating radiance over the hemisphere, providing accurate shadowing unlike typical raster renderers that use directional lights.
